opex.text: Liquidity relates primarily to the Company’s ability to fund loan demand, meet deposit customers’ withdrawal requirements and provide for operating expenses. Assets used to satisfy these needs consist of cash and due from banks, federal funds sold, interest-earning deposits in other financial institutions, securities available-for-sale and loans held for sale. These assets are commonly referred to as liquid assets. Liquid assets totaled $287.3 million at September 30, 2026, compared to $263.1 million at December 31, 2025.

costs.text: Liquidity relates primarily to the Company’s ability to fund loan demand, meet deposit customers’ withdrawal requirements and provide for operating expenses. Assets used to satisfy these needs consist of cash and due from banks, federal funds sold, interest-earning deposits in other financial institutions, securities available-for-sale and loans held for sale. These assets are commonly referred to as liquid assets. Liquid assets totaled $287.3 million at September 30, 2026, compared to $263.1 million at December 31, 2025.

prov.text: Provision for Credit Losses: The third quarter provision for credit losses was $127,000 as compared to a $124,000 provision for the prior year third quarter. The Company had net charge offs of $18,000 for the third quarter of 2026 compared to net charge offs of $2,000 for the year-ago quarter. The provision expense included zero-growth related provision, and a provision of $127,000 for the growth in unfunded commitments. Total delinquent loans ended the quarter at $4.1 million, or 0.34 percent of total loans, with nonperforming assets down 12 percent from the prior year.

nonint.text: Consolidated Noninterest Expense: Total noninterest expense for the third quarter of 2026 was $13.1 million, which was up $1.7 million compared to $11.5 million in the prior year third quarter. The quarter included higher expenses related to incentive accruals and other employee benefits as well as costs related to our pending client and product conversions.

nonop.text: Consolidated Noninterest Expense: Total noninterest expense for the third quarter of 2026 was $13.1 million, which was up $1.7 million compared to $11.5 million in the prior year third quarter. The quarter included higher expenses related to incentive accruals and other employee benefits as well as costs related to our pending client and product conversions.

tax.text: Income Taxes: Income taxes for the third quarter of 2026 were $0.85 million (17.6 percent) compared to $0.91 million (18.4 percent) for the third quarter of 2025.

net.text: Net Income: Net income for the third quarter of 2026 was $3.9 million compared to net income of $4.0 million for the third quarter of 2025, a decrease of $0.1 million, or 2.5 percent. Diluted earnings per share (“DEPS”) of $0.63 for the third quarter of 2026 were lower compared to the DEPS of $0.64 for the third quarter of 2025. Net income for the third quarter of 2026 was positively impacted by higher interest income on loans, partially offset by higher interest expense on deposits and wholesale borrowings. The quarter included a small recapture of Mortgage Servicing Rights (“OMSR”) of $0.04 million. Total noninterest income was $4.7 million and increased slightly compared to the prior year third quarter. Mortgage loan volume was higher as compared to the prior year by 15 percent, with sales of originated mortgages for the third quarter of 2026 also up slightly as compared to the same period in 2025.

ocf.text: The Company experienced positive cash flows from operating activities for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, and September 30, 2025. Net cash provided by operating activities was $12.6 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, and $15.8 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025. Highlights for the current year include $192.3 million in proceeds from the sale of loans, which is up $12.3 million from the prior year. Originations of loans held for sale was a use of cash of $193.6 million, which is up $17.7 million from the prior year. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, there was a gain on sale of loans of $4.0 million, and depreciation and amortization on premises and equipment of $1.7 million.

da.text: The Company experienced positive cash flows from operating activities for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, and September 30, 2025. Net cash provided by operating activities was $12.6 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, and $15.8 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025. Highlights for the current year include $192.3 million in proceeds from the sale of loans, which is up $12.3 million from the prior year. Originations of loans held for sale was a use of cash of $193.6 million, which is up $17.7 million from the prior year. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, there was a gain on sale of loans of $4.0 million, and depreciation and amortization on premises and equipment of $1.7 million.

Net interest income.text: Consolidated Revenue: Operating revenue, consisting of net interest income (“NII”) and noninterest income, was $18.1 million for the third quarter of 2026, an increase of $1.5 million, or 9.0 percent, from the $16.6 million generated during the third quarter of 2025.

Noninterest income.text: Consolidated Revenue: Operating revenue, consisting of net interest income (“NII”) and noninterest income, was $18.1 million for the third quarter of 2026, an increase of $1.5 million, or 9.0 percent, from the $16.6 million generated during the third quarter of 2025.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Long-term investments
lines.why: Securities held for their return: financial. A stake in another business that is part of operations is operating.

lines.name: Debt securities
lines.why: Bonds held for sale or to maturity: financial.

lines.name: Loans, net of the allowance
lines.why: Lending is a bank's business: operating.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Deposits
lines.why: Customers' money a bank holds is its business: operating.

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
